asymmetry_area_ratio_threshold.description: Distribution of visual_asymmetry.area_ratio; same fires/unsure tiering as asymmetry_contrast_ratio_threshold.

asymmetry_contrast_ratio_threshold.description: Distribution of visual_asymmetry.contrast_ratio; attribute_agents/asymmetry.py fires at/above p75, is unsure in [median, p75).

asymmetry_position_delta_px_threshold.description: Distribution of |visual_asymmetry.vertical_position_delta_px|; the third dimension attribute_agents/asymmetry.py checks alongside contrast and area.

claim_min_elapsed_hours_for_verdict.description: Minimum elapsed time between a claim's first and last observed revisit before a verdict is attempted at all -- below this, verdict is always insufficient_data.

claim_unchanged_hours_before_implausible.description: Hours a non-timer claim (stock count, deadline phrase, etc.) can stay byte-identical before that's treated as implausible for a live, genuine claim.

complexity_option_count_threshold.description: Distribution of complexity_metrics.option_counts[].option_count per decision point; goal-scoped lookups supported the same way as complexity_reading_grade_threshold.

complexity_reading_grade_threshold.description: Global default distribution of Flesch-Kincaid grade level for consent/cancellation copy. Goal-scoped overrides ("complexity_reading_grade_threshold::<goal_id>") are tried first by attribute_agents/complexity.py -- see e.g. the cancel_subscription entry below -- so inherent per-goal complexity isn't measured against an unrelated goal's norm.

complexity_reading_grade_threshold::canc.description: Goal-scoped override for cancel_subscription: cancellation copy tends to run denser than the global default even on honest sites (terms/legal framing), so the same absolute grade level means less on this goal specifically.

complexity_total_actions_threshold.description: Distribution of complexity_metrics.total_actions_required; goal-scoped lookups supported the same way as complexity_reading_grade_threshold.

covertness_contrast_ratio_threshold.description: UNUSED as of the covertness stub (Stage 2, LLM judgement) -- kept for a future LLM-backed covertness agent.

deception_min_evidence_count.description: Minimum count of implausible claims/timer resets/no-network state-change actions needed for attribute_agents/deception.py to fire -- 1 means any single occurrence is enough.

disparate_treatment_ratio_threshold.description: UNUSED as of the disparate_treatment stub (Stage 2, LLM judgement) -- kept for a future LLM-backed agent.

information_hiding_price_increase_ratio_.description: UNUSED as of the information_hiding stub (Stage 2, LLM judgement) -- kept for a future LLM-backed agent.

restriction_forced_interstitial_count_th.description: Distribution of forced_interstitial event counts (evidence.path_deviation) for a paired episode; attribute_agents/restriction.py's second, independent firing path alongside friction_ratio.

restriction_friction_ratio_threshold.description: Distribution of friction_metrics.friction_ratio; attribute_agents/restriction.py fires at/above p75*restriction_p75_factor, is unsure in [p75, p75*factor).

restriction_p75_factor.description: Multiplier applied to a distribution's p75 before attribute_agents/restriction.py commits to 'fires' rather than 'unsure' -- the task's 'configurable factor'.

timer_drift_tolerance_seconds.description: How far a countdown's observed remaining-time may deviate from (previous remaining - elapsed wall clock) before being treated as a reset rather than capture-timing noise.
